text_block_list.text: One day—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Today is~ honey bread day~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's the last one! Lucky! Mine for the 
taking—wha?!
Phew, made it just in ti—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Teio-san, you're having honey bread 
too!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... What would Spe-chan do in a 
situation like thisâ)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I won't give it to you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, let's wager some honey 
buns on this contest!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: (Kinda like that...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Shall we split it in half?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Then whoever wins the race gets 
the bread—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A running showdown?! Turbo wants in too! 
Turbo's gonna do it! And Turbo's gonna 
win!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, no, we're not doing it. Looks 
like I had the wrong idea—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh... Could it be, Teio, you're 
scared of losing?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: T-That's not what I'm talking about!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! A contest over bread, sounds great! 
In that case, the honey bread is—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I won't give it to you!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Geez~~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...The honey bread is miiine!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I looost~~... But it was so much fun! Kind 
of felt like a sports day!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *pant*... *wheeze*... *gasp*... 
...I-'m s-o-o-o tired...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... That's true. I was getting a 
little peckish anyway.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Well then, let's share it amongst 
everyone! That was the plan in the first 
place, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Honey bread after a good workout is the 
absolute best, after all! ♪

Afterward, everyone shared and ate the 
honey buns together.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san... A match is a match! Here I go, 
thank you for the win!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ugh…… How could I loseee~~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez! I'm going to train! I won't lose 
next time, just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *pant*... *wheeze*... *gasp*... 
W-What, you're going for another lap...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
T-Turbo will... take on... that 
challenge... toooo...!
